nodes.summary: Shared detector utilities implementing z-score based outlier detection on tile metrics and standardized Finding construction for page-level forensic signals.

nodes.name: blur_detector.py

nodes.name: _make_finding

nodes.summary: Evaluates each embedded image's effective DPI against minimum thresholds and emits low_dpi findings with confidence scaled by deficit.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Identifies rare fonts and excessive font diversity across the document, emitting rare_font and too_many_fonts findings.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Detects tiles with abnormally low OCR confidence by applying low-side z-score analysis on ocr_confidence tile metrics.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Flags embedded images with asymmetric scale_x and scale_y values indicating non-uniform stretching or squashing.

nodes.summary: Computes blur metrics via Laplacian variance on grayscale images, exposing a standard analyze() wrapper for the visual engine.

nodes.name: rms_contrast
nodes.summary: Calculates root-mean-square contrast from grayscale pixel standard deviation.

nodes.summary: Computes Michelson contrast from min/max grayscale intensities with zero-range guard.

nodes.name: analyze
nodes.summary: Returns both RMS and Michelson contrast metrics for a tile image.

nodes.summary: Runs Canny edge detection and returns the fraction of edge pixels in the image.

nodes.summary: Returns Shannon entropy using histogram bin count from config.
